spells.name: Contract
spells.desc: Binds a Single Enemy in an infernal contract for 3 turns: every time they deal damage, the demon collects 40% of it as healing. The fine print always favors the fiend.

spells.name: Devour Soul
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets with Contract or Soul-Bound. Heals the caster for part of the damage dealt.

spells.name: Hellmouth
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY magic damage to All Enemies in a line. Leaves lava tiles behind.

spells.name: Demonic Roar
spells.desc: Terrifying roar. All enemies within 2 tiles are Feared for a round.

spells.name: Shadow Crush
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy. Applies Slow.

spells.name: Swing Door
spells.desc: Mind the door. Shoot a door onto an EMPTY tile beside an enemy within 3 — the hinge — and it swings through them: WEAK physical damage, Staggered, and they are pushed 2 tiles straight away from the hinge. Pick the hinge on the far side and you pick where they land.

spells.name: Breaking and Entering
spells.desc: Nobody said the door had to be yours. Shoot a door down beside an enemy within 4 tiles you can see and come through it: WEAK physical damage, always a rear attack.

spells.name: Underdog Spirit
spells.desc: Nobody believed in you. Good. Raises the caster's ATK by 2 stages and cleanses a debuff.

spells.name: Drop In
spells.desc: Uninvited. Shoot a door into the air over an enemy within 5 tiles you can see and drop out of it onto them: HEAVY physical damage, always a rear attack, worse on a Staggered target, and every other enemy beside the landing takes WEAK physical damage from the slam.

spells.name: Elbow Grease
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. No tricks, no magic — just honest work.

spells.name: Air Mail
spells.desc: Return to sender. Shoot a door at an enemy within 4 tiles: they go in, and a door opens three storeys over their head for them to fall out of. MEDIUM physical damage from the landing, flyers are grounded, the target is Staggered.

spells.name: Suppressive Fire
spells.desc: Deals WEAK physical damage to All Enemies in a line. Applies Slow.

spells.name: Incendiary Rounds
spells.desc: Loads a magazine of incendiary rounds: for 2 rounds every landed basic attack sets the target on fire (Burn, 2 rounds).

spells.name: Rangefinder
spells.desc: Glass a distant area of the map, granting vision for several turns. Every barrage starts with a spotter.

spells.name: Fire for Effect
spells.desc: Calls in the whole battery on a marked grid. At the end of the round, deals HEAVY physical damage to All Enemies inside (AOE). Leaves scorched tiles behind. Reshapes the ground on impact. Deals bonus damage to Burning targets.

spells.name: Fortify
spells.desc: Grants a damage-absorbing shield to a Single Ally.

spells.name: Tesla Coil
spells.desc: Deploy an electrified coil. Detonates when an enemy steps on it. 3×3 shock damage to enemies only. Placing on an empty tile never ends your turn or uses your spell slot; throwing it directly onto an enemy shocks them on contact and ends your turn.

spells.name: Scrap Mine
spells.desc: Nails, powder, a spring. Cheap. Sets a mine: the first enemy to step on it sets off a HEAVY blast in a 3×3 that Staggers enemies only. Two per caster.

spells.name: 5G Tower
spells.desc: Deploy a 5G radio tower (3 hits to destroy). Its signal scrambles thought — enemies within 4 tiles lose 8 M DEF while it stands. Max 1 per Engineer.

spells.name: Overtinker
spells.desc: One more adjustment. One MORE. Grants a heavy damage-absorbing shield to All Allies (and contraptions) around the caster.

spells.name: Ankle Biter
spells.desc: Straight for the tendon. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy beside you and Slows them for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Repair
spells.desc: Restores a MEDIUM amount of HP to a Single Ally.

spells.name: Rocket Fist
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.

spells.name: Cluster Rockets
spells.desc: A shoulder rack of rockets rains on a 3×3. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to All Enemies in an AOE. Applies Burn.

spells.name: Overclock
spells.desc: Empowers a Single Ally. Raises ATK by 1 stage and MOV by 1.

spells.name: Synthetic Blade
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Lowers DEF by 1 stage. Deals bonus damage to targets with Jammed.

spells.name: Taser Bolt
spells.desc: Two prongs into the housing. Systems stutter. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy and Jams it for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Heat Ray
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Applies Burn.

spells.name: Plasma Whip

spells.name: Sneak Slash
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage while invisible. Deals bonus damage to Poisoned targets.

spells.name: Photon Scatter
spells.desc: Deals WEAK magic damage to All Enemies around the caster (AOE).

spells.name: Contract
spells.desc: Binds a Single Enemy in an infernal contract for 3 turns: every time they deal damage, the demon collects 40% of it as healing. The fine print always favors the fiend.

spells.name: Devour Soul
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets with Contract or Soul-Bound. Heals the caster for part of the damage dealt.

spells.name: Hellmouth
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY magic damage to All Enemies in a line. Leaves lava tiles behind.

spells.name: Demonic Roar
spells.desc: Terrifying roar. All enemies within 2 tiles are Feared for a round.

spells.name: Shadow Crush
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy. Applies Slow.

spells.name: Swing Door
spells.desc: Mind the door. Shoot a door onto an EMPTY tile beside an enemy within 3 — the hinge — and it swings through them: WEAK physical damage, Staggered, and they are pushed 2 tiles straight away from the hinge. Pick the hinge on the far side and you pick where they land.

spells.name: Breaking and Entering
spells.desc: Nobody said the door had to be yours. Shoot a door down beside an enemy within 4 tiles you can see and come through it: WEAK physical damage, always a rear attack.

spells.name: Underdog Spirit
spells.desc: Nobody believed in you. Good. Raises the caster's ATK by 2 stages and cleanses a debuff.

spells.name: Drop In
spells.desc: Uninvited. Shoot a door into the air over an enemy within 5 tiles you can see and drop out of it onto them: HEAVY physical damage, always a rear attack, worse on a Staggered target, and every other enemy beside the landing takes WEAK physical damage from the slam.

spells.name: Elbow Grease
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. No tricks, no magic — just honest work.

spells.name: Air Mail
spells.desc: Return to sender. Shoot a door at an enemy within 4 tiles: they go in, and a door opens three storeys over their head for them to fall out of. MEDIUM physical damage from the landing, flyers are grounded, the target is Staggered.

spells.name: Suppressive Fire
spells.desc: Deals WEAK physical damage to All Enemies in a line. Applies Slow.

spells.name: Incendiary Rounds
spells.desc: Loads a magazine of incendiary rounds: for 2 rounds every landed basic attack sets the target on fire (Burn, 2 rounds).

spells.name: Rangefinder
spells.desc: Glass a distant area of the map, granting vision for several turns. Every barrage starts with a spotter.

spells.name: Fire for Effect
spells.desc: Calls in the whole battery on a marked grid. At the end of the round, deals HEAVY physical damage to All Enemies inside (AOE). Leaves scorched tiles behind. Reshapes the ground on impact. Deals bonus damage to Burning targets.

spells.name: Fortify
spells.desc: Grants a damage-absorbing shield to a Single Ally.

spells.name: Tesla Coil
spells.desc: Deploy an electrified coil. Detonates when an enemy steps on it. 3×3 shock damage to enemies only. Placing on an empty tile never ends your turn or uses your spell slot; throwing it directly onto an enemy shocks them on contact and ends your turn.

spells.name: Scrap Mine
spells.desc: Nails, powder, a spring. Cheap. Sets a mine: the first enemy to step on it sets off a HEAVY blast in a 3×3 that Staggers enemies only. Two per caster.

spells.name: 5G Tower
spells.desc: Deploy a 5G radio tower (3 hits to destroy). Its signal scrambles thought — enemies within 4 tiles lose 8 M DEF while it stands. Max 1 per Engineer.

spells.name: Overtinker
spells.desc: One more adjustment. One MORE. Grants a heavy damage-absorbing shield to All Allies (and contraptions) around the caster.

spells.name: Ankle Biter
spells.desc: Straight for the tendon. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy beside you and Slows them for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Repair
spells.desc: Restores a MEDIUM amount of HP to a Single Ally.

spells.name: Rocket Fist
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.

spells.name: Cluster Rockets
spells.desc: A shoulder rack of rockets rains on a 3×3. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to All Enemies in an AOE. Applies Burn.

spells.name: Overclock
spells.desc: Empowers a Single Ally. Raises ATK by 1 stage and MOV by 1.

spells.name: Synthetic Blade
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Lowers DEF by 1 stage. Deals bonus damage to targets with Jammed.

spells.name: Taser Bolt
spells.desc: Two prongs into the housing. Systems stutter. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy and Jams it for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Heat Ray
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Applies Burn.

spells.name: Plasma Whip
spells.desc: The whip cracks down the lane. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies in a line up to 3 tiles long and sets them alight. It reaches further than it should and burns where it lands.

spells.name: Sneak Slash
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage while invisible. Deals bonus damage to Poisoned targets.

spells.name: Photon Scatter
spells.desc: Deals WEAK magic damage to All Enemies around the caster (AOE).

spells.name: Love Bite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Lowers the target's DEF by 1 stage.

spells.name: Dream Siphon
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets with Stun. Heals the caster for part of the damage dealt.

spells.name: Sleep Paralysis
spells.desc: Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy. It cannot move or act: Stunned for a round.

spells.name: Eternal Slumber
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY magic damage to All Enemies in an AOE.

spells.name: Kinetic Hurl
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy. Knocks the target straight back.

spells.name: Psychic Beam
spells.desc: Deals WEAK magic damage to All Enemies in a line. Lowers ATK by 2 stages and DEF by 1 stage.

spells.name: Telepathic Link
spells.desc: Empowers All Allies nearby. Raises M ATK by 1 stage.

spells.name: Plandemic

spells.desc: For science. Hold still. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy within 2 and inflicts Grievous Wound for 2 rounds (healing halved).

spells.desc: It eats the plate first. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy and lowers its DEF by 1 stage.

spells.desc: IT'S ALIVE! Stitch a creation together on an adjacent tile. At the end of every round it lumbers 3 tiles toward the nearest enemy and clubs for 90. 4 hits to destroy — physical blows only count for half. One creation per scientist.

spells.name: Tesla Coil
spells.desc: Deploy an electrified coil. Detonates when an enemy steps on it. 3×3 shock damage to enemies only. Placing on an empty tile never ends your turn or uses your spell slot; throwing it directly onto an enemy shocks them on contact and ends your turn.

spells.name: Scrap Mine
spells.desc: Nails, powder, a spring. Cheap. Sets a mine: the first enemy to step on it sets off a HEAVY blast in a 3×3 that Staggers enemies only. Two per caster.
